page:
Troubleshooting guide for Vite issues including CLI, config, dev server, HMR, build, optimized dependencies, and performance bottlenecks.
- CLI error: 'Cannot find module' with & in Windows path - use pnpm/yarn or remove &
- ESM-only packages: require() fails, use dynamic import() or set 'type': 'module' in package.json
- File descriptor limits (Linux): ulimit -Sn command for adjustment
- inotify limits: fs.inotify.max_queued_events, max_user_instances, max_user_watches configuration
- ENOSPC error: file watcher limit exceeded, increase fs.inotify.max_user_watches to 524288
- server.watch.ignored and server.watch.usePolling options
- Self-signed SSL certificates: Chrome ignores caching, use trusted cert
- 431 Request Header Fields Too Large: Node.js limit, use --max-http-header-size flag
- server.host: set to 127.0.0.1 for VS Code dev containers
- HMR file case sensitivity issues
- WSL2 file watching problems
- Circular dependencies in HMR
- CORS errors with file:// protocol
- Case sensitivity on different filesystems
- 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module' error: version skew, network, browser extensions
- build.rolldownOptions.output.chunkFileNames option
- Module externalization warnings
- Strict mode requirements in ESM
- Browser extension interference
- Cross drive links on Windows (subst, mklink)
- Default import from CJS modules
How do I fix 'Cannot find module' with & in path? How do I resolve ESM-only package errors? What causes ENOSPC errors? How do I configure inotify limits? How do I fix dynamic import failures?

sections.manifest:
CLI troubleshooting.
- Windows path with &: breaks npm, switch to pnpm/yarn or remove &
- GitHub Discussions for help
- Vite Land Discord #help channel
How do I fix Windows paths containing & character?

Config troubleshooting.
- ESM-only packages: 'require() of ES Module' error
- Node.js <=22 limitation with --experimental-require-module flag
- Solutions: add 'type': 'module' to package.json or rename to .mjs/.mts files
How do I handle ESM-only packages in Vite config?

Dev server troubleshooting.
- Requests stalled forever (Linux): file descriptor and inotify limits
- ulimit -Sn: check and increase file descriptor limit to 10000
- sysctl fs.inotify: check/set max_queued_events (16384), max_user_instances (8192), max_user_watches (524288)
- Systemd config: DefaultLimitNOFILE=65536 in /etc/systemd/system.conf or /etc/systemd/user.conf
- Ubuntu: /etc/security/limits.conf with '* - nofile 65536'
- Restart required for persistence
- VS Code dev container: server.host set to 127.0.0.1
- ENOSPC error: Linux file watcher limit (~8192-10000), solution: increase max_user_watches
- server.watch.ignored option to exclude directories
- server.watch.usePolling for file polling (higher CPU)
- Network requests with self-signed SSL: Chrome ignores caching directives
- 431 Request Header Fields Too Large: Node.js limit for header size
- Use --max-http-header-size to change limit
How do I fix requests stalling on Linux? What are inotify limits? How do I fix ENOSPC errors? How do I configure for dev containers?

HMR troubleshooting.
- File change not triggering HMR: file case sensitivity (import './Foo.js' vs './foo.js')
- WSL2 file watching limitations
- Full reload instead of HMR: HMR not handled by Vite or plugin, or circular dependency
- vite --debug hmr: log circular dependency paths
How do I fix HMR issues? What causes case sensitivity problems?

Build troubleshooting.
- Built file CORS error with file:// protocol: scripts fail to run
- Solution: use http protocol via 'npx vite preview'
- Case sensitivity filesystem differences: ENOENT or 'Module not found' errors
- 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module' error: version skew, network, browser extensions
- Version skew: old cached HTML references deleted chunks, deploy new chunks alongside old ones
- Service worker for asset prefetching
- build.rolldownOptions.output.chunkFileNames: select different chunk names to avoid extension blocking
How do I fix CORS errors in built files? What causes case sensitivity errors? How do I fix dynamic import fetch errors?

Optimized dependencies troubleshooting.
- Outdated pre-bundled deps with linked local packages
- Hash key depends on: package lock contents, patches, bundling config options
- npm overrides, pnpm overrides, yarn resolutions supported
- npm link: not detected, use vite --force to re-optimize
- Alternative: use npm/pnpm/yarn overrides for dependency replacement
How do I update pre-bundled dependencies with local packages?

Performance profiling.
- CPU profiling with vite --profile or vite build --profile
- Generates vite-profile-0.cpuprofile in root (or --profile <name>.cpuprofile)
- Upload to https://www.speedscope.app/ for inspection
- vite-plugin-inspect: inspect intermediate plugin state
- Works in both dev and build modes
How do I profile Vite for performance bottlenecks?

Other troubleshooting.
- Module externalized warning: Node.js modules used in browser code
- Recommendation: avoid Node.js modules for browser to reduce bundle size
- Add polyfills manually if needed
- Report issue to third-party library using Node.js modules
- Syntax/Type errors in non-strict mode code
- ESM always uses strict mode, with statements not supported
- 'Cannot create property on boolean' error
- patch-package, yarn patch, pnpm patch for workarounds
- Browser extensions blocking Vite client: white screen without errors
- Try disabling extensions if 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module'
- Cross drive links on Windows: subst command or mklink to different drive
- Default import returns module.exports for CJS vs module.exports.default
- 'Element type is invalid' or 'foo is not a function' errors
How do I handle Node.js modules in browser? What causes strict mode errors? How do I fix extension-related issues?
